sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 285 AND 305 AND cls = 'day_1_5' GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy;
